subject: general
question:
Study the given pie charts and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ac36cb2f560a5b31ade9a205aaabaa22e04dba5d3032cd01ae5431e19e7234.png] 

Total Number of Students appeared = 1800

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf4b163e7149d4a79bbc8943a37597b266241b7e63ac8970e8977c761f1a8c4.png] 

Total Number of Students passed = 1200

The number of students who passed from institute C exceeds the number of students who appeared from institute E is x. The value of x lies between:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of students who passed from institute C = 1200 × 18/100

⇒ 216

Number of students who appeared from institute E = 1800 × 40°/360°

⇒ 200

Difference = 216 - 200 = 16

So, x = 16

It is between 14 and 18

**∴ The value of x lies between 14 and 18**
